scenarios.scenario_abstract: While thrift shopping, [X] fills twenty-two matchbox-scale cubbies in a Southern Gothic shelf, building saved searches around miniature faith objects, mourning portraits, aged keys and heart locks, butterflies, feathers, tiny bones or skulls, and dried botanicals instead of buying a random themed bundle.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 逛旧货店时，[X]会为南方哥特式小格架填充二十二个火柴盒大小的格子，围绕微型信仰物件、悼念肖像、旧钥匙与心形锁、蝴蝶、羽毛、小型骨骼或头骨和干燥植物建立收藏搜索，而不是随便买一包主题混搭物。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While making a first oil painting for a partner's birthday, [X] compares a recognizable portrait, a shared place, a meaningful animal or flower, a constellation, and a simple private love symbol, then checks which subject can be simplified, painted with available materials, dried, and finished in time.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 初次为伴侣生日制作油画时，[X]会在可识别肖像、共同地点、有意义的动物或花朵、星座和简洁的私人爱情符号之间比较，再确认哪个主题能被简化、用现有材料完成并在期限前干燥。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When creating a short picture book for two children, [X] uses sibling protagonists close to their real ages, combines space facts with kindness and adventure, revises the friendly alien's identity twice, and finishes with a dedication to the family's 'two little astronauts.'
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为两个孩子制作短篇绘本时，[X]会以年龄接近他们本人的兄妹为主角，把太空知识、善意和冒险结合起来，两次修改友好外星角色的身份，最后题献给家里的“两个小宇航员”。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: With family members, [X] turns phrases they already use, such as stars for a delivery and a bluebird for parents coming home, into a private communication system. They test abbreviations, an apple home-status icon, urgency colors, timing, vibrations, gestures, and decoy sentences until the cues remain memorable to relatives but opaque to outsiders.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]和家人把原本就在使用的短语，例如用星星代表外卖到达、用蓝鸟代表父母回家，整理成私人通信系统，再测试缩写、苹果形居家状态图标、紧急颜色、时间码、振动、手势和掩护句，直到这些线索对亲属好记、对外人难懂。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While watching documentaries, [X] narrows a broad animal interest to ocean life, follows dolphins from social behavior into echolocation, and keeps exploring octopus camouflage, clownfish symbiosis, whale migration, seahorse reproduction, and conservation until one marine creature becomes a personally resonant visual subject.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 观看纪录片时，[X]会把广泛的动物兴趣收窄到海洋生命，从海豚的社会行为一路追问到回声定位，又继续探索章鱼变色、小丑鱼共生、鲸迁徙、海马繁殖和动物保护，直到某种海洋生物成为具有个人共鸣的视觉主题。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: At the start of learning to draw, [X] turns a general wish into portrait practice, working from facial structure and individual features toward repeated full-face studies, then choosing pencils, paper, and books that let recognizability improve through short daily sessions.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 刚开始学习绘画时，[X]会把笼统愿望转化为肖像练习，从面部结构与单个五官逐步走向反复的完整人像研究，并选择适合短时日常练习、能逐步提高辨识度的铅笔、纸张和书籍。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When preparing a birthday keepsake for a husband, [X] centers one durable message: he is a deeply loved partner and father, and his family will always have his back. [X] refines the idea into a handwritten card and a short everyday inscription whose words remain clear without generic decorative symbols.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为丈夫准备生日纪念物时，[X]会围绕一条长期有效的信息展开：他是深受爱戴的伴侣和父亲，家人会一直支持他。[X]把想法收敛成手写卡片和简短的日常刻字，让文字本身清晰有力，而不依赖泛化装饰符号。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While making an at-home birthday invitation, [X] asks for a colorful flower treatment, keeps the preferred floral border, and repeatedly clarifies that pink must fill the whole background rather than merely recolor the flowers or text, exposing whether the visual request is actually followed.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 制作居家生日邀请函时，[X]会要求使用彩色花卉装饰，保留自己喜欢的花边，并反复澄清粉色应填满整个背景，而不是只改变花朵或文字的颜色，从而检验视觉要求是否真的被执行。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While studying the Day of the Dead, [X] traces how marigolds guide remembrance, skull imagery treats death with respect and humor, and altars, candles, photographs, food, and paper art hold family memory, distinguishing culturally grounded symbols from decorative use stripped of meaning.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 学习亡灵节时，[X]会追问万寿菊如何引导纪念、头骨形象如何以尊重和幽默面对死亡，以及祭坛、蜡烛、照片、食物和剪纸如何承载家庭记忆，并区分有文化根基的符号与脱离含义的表面装饰。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Wanting to start drawing immediately, [X] narrows a nature study from plants versus animals to one quick animal subject built from forgiving shapes, compares a bird, small mammal, lizard, or insect near a simple flower or branch, and chooses what can be finished without detailed anatomy.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 希望立刻动笔时，[X]会把自然写生从植物与动物之间的选择收窄到一个由容易把握的基础形状构成的快速动物主题，在鸟、小型哺乳动物、蜥蜴或花枝附近的昆虫之间比较，再选择无需复杂解剖也能完成的对象。
